audit.accesskey_dup_rem: Duplicated accesskeys trigger the wrong control and clash with browser shortcuts; remove or make unique.
audit.aria_hidden_focusable: {n} interactive elements (<{tag}>) with aria-hidden="true": hidden from the screen reader yet still focusable.
audit.aria_hidden_focusable_rem: Remove aria-hidden from the focusable element, or add tabindex="-1" if it must stay out of interaction.
audit.aria_ref_missing: {n} aria-labelledby/describedby references point to ids that do not exist: {ej}.
audit.aria_ref_missing_rem: Fix or remove the reference: a broken aria-labelledby leaves the control with no accessible name.
audit.aria_value_invalid: {n} invalid ARIA attribute values: {ej}. Assistive tech ignores them.
audit.aria_value_invalid_rem: Boolean aria-* only accept true/false/undefined, position ones integers, token ones their closed list (4.1.2). Fix or drop the attribute.
audit.audio_desc_missing: {n} <video> without audio-description track (1.2.3/1.2.5): pending human judgment.
audit.audio_desc_missing_rem: If the video carries essential visual information not narrated, publish audio description (track kind="descriptions" or alternative) — a person watching the video decides.
audit.autocomplete: {n} fields collecting user information without an autocomplete attribute: {ej}.
audit.autocomplete_invalid: {n} invalid autocomplete token values: {ej}. Tokens must come from the HTML autofill standard (§7.5) or assistive tech cannot identify the purpose (1.3.5).
audit.autocomplete_invalid_rem: Use standard tokens: email, tel, name, postal-code, one-time-code… (full list in the tool).
audit.autocomplete_rem: Add autocomplete with the right token (email, tel, name, postal-code…, 1.3.5): free accessibility and autofill at zero cost.
audit.blank_no_warning: {n} links with target="_blank" that do not warn they open a new window.
audit.blank_no_warning_rem: Add a text hint (or title/aria-label): "(opens in a new window)", or let the user decide.
audit.captcha: Captcha detected ({ej}): 3.3.8 requires a non-cognitive-test alternative for access.
audit.captcha_rem: Offer alternatives: magic links, OAuth, human support. A CAPTCHA without an alternative excludes (3.3.8, new in WCAG 2.2 AA).
audit.char_shortcut_rem: Single-key shortcuts must be disablable, remappable, or active only on focus (2.1.4): voice-dictation users trigger every letter.
audit.click_nonfocusable: {n} non-interactive elements (<{tag}>) with onclick, no role, no tabindex and no keyboard handling.
audit.click_nonfocusable_rem: Use a real <button>; if impossible, add role="button", tabindex="0" and Enter/Space handling (2.1.1).
audit.color_only_link: Links distinguishable only by color detected in the rendered pass (1.4.1).
audit.color_only_link_rem: A link inside text needs underline or another cue, or ≥3:1 contrast against surrounding text (1.4.1).
audit.ctrl_name: {n} <{tag}> with no accessible name (no text, aria-label or title).
audit.ctrl_name_rem: The accessible name comes from inner text, aria-label, title, or an inner image with alt. An empty control is invisible to screen readers.
audit.dom_visual_order: DOM order differs from visual order in {n} text blocks: review with keyboard (1.3.2).
audit.dom_visual_order_rem: Programmatic reading order must match visual order: check flex order, grid placement and position absolute (1.3.2).
audit.down_event_rem: Activate on the UP event (onclick/onmouseup): dragging away can abort — that is rule 2.5.2.
audit.drag_no_alt: {n} drag handlers with no visible click/button alternative: {ej}. Review (2.5.7).
audit.drag_no_alt_rem: Every drag action needs a non-dragging alternative: up/down buttons, context menu, arrows (2.5.7).
audit.dup_ids: {n} duplicated ids; they can break label-for and aria-labelledby associations.
audit.dup_ids_rem: Make ids unique: <label for> and aria-labelledby only point at the first match.
audit.element_lang_invalid_rem:
Foreign-language fragments carry lang with a valid code (3.1.2):
…
.
audit.empty_heading_rem: Remove empty headings or give them text: they show up as gaps in the reader's index.
audit.field_label: {n} form fields with no associated <label> and no accessible name.
audit.field_label_rem: Associate <label for="id"> (or wrap the field), or use aria-label. Applies to input, select and textarea.
audit.fieldset_missing: {n} radio/checkbox groups without <fieldset><legend>: screen readers do not announce the common question (1.3.1).
audit.fieldset_missing_rem: Wrap groups in <fieldset><legend>Common question</legend>…</fieldset> (1.3.1): without it, each radio is announced without context.
audit.financial_no_confirm: {n} financial/legal form(s) without a detectable confirmation step (3.3.4).
audit.financial_no_confirm_rem: Submissions with legal/financial consequences must be reversible, checked, or confirmed (3.3.4): terms checkbox, "Review and confirm" button, or review step.
audit.forced_colors_svg: {n} SVGs with hardcoded colored fill: under forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) the fill falls back to inherited and the icon can turn invisible.
audit.forced_colors_svg_rem: Use fill="currentColor" (inherits text color, which the system already adjusts) or the system keywords (CanvasText).
audit.generic_link_rem: Describe the destination in the link text (2.4.4): people listing links jump between them with no context.
audit.gesture_no_click: {n} gesture/drag handlers with no visible click alternative: {ej}. Review (2.5.1).
audit.gesture_no_click_rem: Every gesture function (swipe/drag) needs a non-gesture alternative: prev/next button or plain click (2.5.1).
audit.heading_quality: {n} suspiciously generic or vague headings/labels: {ej}. Review (2.4.6).
audit.heading_quality_rem: Headings should describe their section: "Q3 Report Results", not "Section 2" or "More info" (2.4.6). Name things.
audit.heading_skips_rem: Do not skip levels (h2→h4): it breaks the navigation outline. Descend one level at a time.
audit.help_inconsistent: Help (contact/support) appears in different places or shapes across site pages ({ej}). Review (3.2.6).
audit.help_inconsistent_rem: When help appears on multiple pages, it must appear in the same relative order and consistently (3.2.6, new in 2.2): same menu, same place.
audit.iframe_title_rem: Add a descriptive title to the iframe (screen readers announce it on arrival).
audit.images_of_text: {n} images that appear to be rendered text (very long alt{ej2}). Review (1.4.5).
audit.images_of_text_rem: Except for logotypes, present text as real text (1.4.5): it rescales, reflows and translates; an image does not.
audit.img_no_alt: {n} without an alt attribute (not even alt="").
audit.img_no_alt_rem: Add alt to every : descriptive text when it conveys information, alt="" when decorative. Same requirement for and .
audit.input_img_alt: <input type="image"> without alt (image button with no name).
audit.input_img_alt_rem: Add descriptive alt to the input type="image" (it is its accessible name), or replace it with a <button> with text or <input type="submit" value="…">.
audit.label_in_name: {n} controls whose aria-label does not contain the visible text («{ej}»): voice-input users say what they see (2.5.3).
audit.label_in_name_rem: The accessible name must CONTAIN the visible label: "Summer offers (opens in new window)", not "More info". Use visible text + suffix.
audit.label_orphan: {n} <label> without for and without a nested field: they label nothing.
audit.label_orphan_rem: Connect the label to its field via for="id", or move the field inside the label.
audit.label_vague_rem: Labels should describe the field: "Contact email address", not "Field" or "Text" (2.4.6).
audit.landmark_dup: {n} groups of duplicated landmarks (<nav>, <header>…) without a distinguishing aria-label: {ej}.
audit.landmark_dup_rem: Name each repeated landmark (aria-label="Main menu", aria-label="Footer menu"): otherwise landmark navigation is a lottery.
audit.lang_invalid: lang="{lang}" is not a valid BCP-47 language code.
audit.lang_invalid_rem: Use the correct ISO 639 primary subtag (en, es, pt…).
audit.lang_missing: The <html> element does not declare lang.
audit.lang_missing_rem: Add lang="en" (the real language) to <html>: screen readers pick the synthetic voice from it.
audit.lang_region_invalid: lang “{l}”: the region subtag does not exist (ISO 3166). Use the language alone (“en”) or a real region (“en-GB”).
audit.lang_region_invalid_rem: Validate the region against the IANA Language Subtag Registry: “en” alone or “en-GB” with a real region.
audit.limits: Automation ≈ one third of WCAG: this is an express filter, not a substitute for manual review (keyboard, screen reader, real contrast, audit rhyme).
audit.list_structure: {n} illegal children inside <ul>/<ol> (only <li>, <script> and <template> are valid).
audit.list_structure_rem: Wrap loose content in <li> or use another container: screen readers announce the list with its item count and skip non-<li> content.
audit.meta_refresh_rem: Replace the automatic reload with user-initiated navigation (2.2.1). Instant redirects are better done server-side.
audit.motion_actuation: {n} deviceorientation/devicemotion handlers with no UI alternative: {ej}. Review (2.5.4).
audit.motion_actuation_rem: What motion activates must also be activatable via UI (button) and disablable (2.5.4).
audit.motion_moving: {n} moving/looping contents with no visible pause control: {ej}. Review (2.2.2).
audit.motion_moving_rem: Content moving/blinking >5s needs a pause/stop mechanism (2.2.2): <marquee> has none; looping animations do not either by default.
audit.multi_h1_rem: Keep a single h1 (page title) and demote the rest one level.
audit.multi_label: {n} fields with more than one associated <label for>.
audit.multi_label_rem: One field, one label: screen readers announce concatenated labels. Merge the text into one.
audit.nav_inconsistent: Repeated navigation changes across site pages ({ej}) (3.2.3).
audit.nav_inconsistent_rem: Repeated navigation mechanisms must appear in the same relative order on every page (3.2.3): shared template.
audit.no_bypass: Neither <main>/role="main" nor a skip link: no way to bypass repeated blocks.
audit.no_bypass_rem: Add <main> (or role="main") and a "Skip to content" link as the first focus stop.
audit.no_h1: There is no <h1> on the page.
audit.no_h1_rem: Add a single h1 naming the page.
audit.no_headings_rem: Structure content with hierarchical headings: they are the screen reader's navigation index.
audit.no_multiple_ways: No alternative way to find pages (no search, no sitemap, no index) across sampled pages (2.4.5).
audit.no_multiple_ways_rem: Offer at least two ways: navigation + search or sitemap (2.4.5).
audit.no_status_regions: No status regions (aria-live/status/alert) detected on the page: dynamic messages will not be announced (4.1.3).
audit.no_status_regions_rem: Add role="status" or aria-live="polite" for toasts, save confirmations, search results (4.1.3).
audit.orientation_lock_rem: Content must not be locked to one orientation unless the exception demonstrably applies (1.3.4): remove screen.orientation.lock() and orientation-forcing media queries.
audit.placeholder_only: {n} fields using placeholder as their only label (no <label>): {ej}. The placeholder vanishes on input (3.3.2).
audit.placeholder_only_rem: Placeholder is NOT a label: add a visible <label for="id">. The placeholder disappears when typing starts and screen readers do not always announce it (3.3.2).
audit.reduced_motion_ignored: {n} looping animations still run with prefers-reduced-motion set (before {n}, after {nr}): the user's preference is ignored (2.2.2).
audit.reduced_motion_ignored_rem: Wrap animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none } — or pause via the Animation API. The user asked for less motion; honor it.
audit.required_no_indication: {n} required fields with no visible required indication: {ej} (3.3.2).
audit.required_no_indication_rem: Required fields must indicate it: asterisk with legend, "required" text in the label, or announced aria-required (3.3.2).
audit.role_required_attr: {n} widgets whose role requires missing ARIA attributes: {ej}.
audit.role_required_attr_rem: A slider needs aria-valuenow (ideally aria-valuemin/max): without the state the widget is inoperative for assistive tech (4.1.2).
audit.role_unknown: {n} unknown ARIA roles: {ej}. Screen readers ignore them.
audit.role_unknown_rem: Use roles from the ARIA specification (button, dialog, navigation…) or drop the attribute and rely on semantic HTML.

same_name_links.one: 1 pair of links with identical text pointing to different destinations.
same_name_links.other: {n} pairs of links with identical text pointing to different destinations.

audit.same_name_links_rem: Differentiate the names (or unify the destination): "Reports" ×3 with three different URLs is a problem for anyone navigating by link list.
audit.score_note: Weighted score: high −12, medium −6, low −2 from 100. It measures only what is automatable (≈1/3 of WCAG): use it to track trends between releases, not as conformance (WCAG-EM-style sampling and scope; not a conformance evaluation). THIS static pass did NOT measure contrast (1.4.3), target size or the criteria in not_measured: a 100 here is not "contrast is fine" — run the rendered audit.
audit.sensory_text: Instructions appealing to senses alone: "{ej}". Review (1.3.3).
audit.sensory_text_rem: Do not instruct by position/shape/color alone ("the button on the right"): name things (1.3.3).
audit.tabindex_pos: {n} elements with a positive tabindex (overrides natural order).
audit.tabindex_pos_rem: Use tabindex="0" or drop the attribute: tab order must follow the DOM.
audit.table_no_th_rem: Mark row/column headers with <th> (plus scope) so the reader can associate cells.
audit.text_spacing_clip: {n} texts clipped when the 1.4.12 spacing overrides apply (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em): review.
audit.text_spacing_clip_rem: Content must survive text-spacing overrides without clipping: replace fixed heights with min-height (1.4.12).
audit.title_generic: Generic title (“{t}”): does not identify this page among the open ones (2.4.2, review).
audit.title_generic_rem: One unique title per page: content + site (“Contact — MaisMedia”), never “Untitled”, “Home” or “Document”.
audit.title_missing: The page has no <title> with content.
audit.title_missing_rem: Write a unique, descriptive <title> per page (screen reader's first announcement, tab text).
audit.video_autoplay: {n} media elements with autoplay (audio >3s with no way to stop it).
audit.video_autoplay_rem: Remove autoplay or add muted + a visible pause/stop control (1.4.2): audio that starts on its own disrupts screen-reader users.
audit.video_captions_rem: Publish captions for the video audio track (1.2.2). If decorative and silent, mark it as such.
audit.zoom_max: The viewport limits zoom (maximum-scale={v}; recommend no limit or ≥2).
audit.zoom_max_rem: Remove maximum-scale from the viewport, or set it to 2 or higher, so text can be enlarged (1.4.4).
audit.zoom_no_rem: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale: zooming is the user's right (1.4.4).

contrast.interp: Text contrast must be evaluated against the REAL background behind it: use worst_ratio to find the most hostile area and area_passes_aa_normal_text_4_5 to know how much surface is safe. If area_passes_aa_normal_text_4_5 < 100% for text over image, you need an overlay/scrim or repositioned alternative text.
contrast.no_box: the element matched by {s} has no visible box to sample
contrast.no_post_copy: no specific copy of the post: base only
contrast.opaque_text: use an opaque color for text over images (no alpha)
contrast.selector_missing: selector {s} not found on the page

docx.docx_fake_headings: {n} paragraphs with just bold/large text: they LOOK like headings but are not — navigation pane and auto-TOC cannot see them (1.3.1).
docx.docx_fake_headings_rem: Apply the "Heading 1/2" style instead of manual bold: then they exist in the navigation pane and the TOC.
docx.docx_no_alt: {n} images with no alternative text (docPr without descr, or empty): invisible to screen readers (1.1.1).
docx.docx_no_alt_rem: Right-click each image → "Edit Alt Text" and describe it. Decorative ones: tick "decorative".
docx.docx_no_lang: document language not declared: synthetic voice and spellcheck cannot pick (3.1.1).
docx.docx_no_lang_rem: Review → Language → set the whole-document language.
docx.docx_table_no_header: {n} tables with no marked header row: cells lose their column context (1.3.1).
docx.docx_table_no_header_rem: Table → mark the header row ("Repeat header rows" for multi-page tables).
docx.limits: Structural XML screening: not a substitute for human review (reading order of complex tables, meaning of under-described images, embedded charts).

dom.contrast_fail: {n} text areas with insufficient contrast: {det}. (computed fg/background, with alpha compositing).
dom.contrast_fail_rem: Raise contrast to ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for large text). The effective background already includes overlays and translucency; with a background image, check that area manually.
dom.contrast_image_fail: {n} text areas over an image/gradient with insufficient contrast, MEASURED by real pixel sampling: {det}.
dom.contrast_image_fail_rem: Add a semi-transparent scrim over the image, darken it, or move the text to a safe zone. The worst ratio marks the hostile area; if the AA-passing area is not 100%, the real background is not safe.
dom.contrast_review: {n} text areas over background images or with text-shadow: not computable, review.
dom.contrast_review_rem: Contrast over a background image could not be measured here: use a11y_contrast_image with a screenshot of that region, or a11y_contrast_dom to measure it directly from the page.
dom.focus_invisible: {n} focusable controls with no apparent focus indicator (outline and box-shadow absent): {det}. Review.
dom.focus_invisible_rem: Guarantee a visible focus indicator: never outline:none without a replacement; use :focus-visible with ≥2px outline or a contrasted border/shadow (2.4.7).
dom.focus_navigates: Receiving focus on {ej} triggered a context change (URL changed to {url}) — 3.2.1.
dom.focus_navigates_rem: Receiving focus must never change context (3.2.1): check focus→location.href, focus→form.submit(), focus→window.open().
dom.focus_not_focusable: {n} controls that never receive focus via .focus(): {det}.
dom.focus_not_focusable_rem: If it must be interactive, make it focusable (tabindex="0"); otherwise remove it from the tab path.
dom.focus_obscured: {n} controls end up hidden behind fixed/sticky elements when focused (sticky headers, banners): {det}. Review (2.4.11).
dom.focus_obscured_rem: Author-fixed content must not hide the focused element (2.4.11, new in WCAG 2.2 AA): set scroll-padding-top to the fixed header height, or make it auto-collapse.
dom.forced_colors_svg: {n} SVGs with hardcoded colored fill: under forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) the fill falls back to inherited and the icon can turn invisible.
dom.forced_colors_svg_rem: Use fill="currentColor" (inherits text color, which the system already adjusts) or the system keywords (CanvasText).
dom.form_error_missing: {n} forms submitted with invalid data with NO error identification: no aria-invalid, aria-describedby with text, role=alert, or error text (3.3.1).
dom.form_error_missing_rem: Errors must be described in text and associated with the field: aria-invalid="true" + a message linked via aria-describedby (or a summary that takes focus on submit). A red border alone is not an identified error.
dom.form_error_no_suggestion: {n} fields with an identified error but no detectable correction suggestion (3.3.3). Review.
dom.form_error_no_suggestion_rem: When the correction is known, say it: "Use DD/MM/YYYY", not "Invalid date" (3.3.3). Suggestion pattern: format/example text near the field.
dom.form_navigated: The form navigates on submit; error behavior is not measurable in-page ({ej}).
dom.form_navigated_rem: Capture the destination page or intercept the submit; judging errors requires the post-submit DOM.
dom.hover_not_dismissible: {n} tooltips/overlays appearing on hover/focus that do NOT dismiss on Escape (1.4.13).
dom.hover_not_dismissible_rem: Hover/focus-triggered content must be dismissible with Escape without moving the pointer (1.4.13): add a keydown Escape handler that hides the tooltip.
dom.input_navigates_rem: Changing a setting must never navigate without user request (3.2.2): add an "Apply" button or confirm before submitting.
dom.kbd_trap: KEYBOARD TRAP: {n} controls caught in a cycle ({cycle}) and Escape does not release. Focus cannot leave (2.1.2).
dom.kbd_trap_rem: Every focus-containing component (modal, menu) must release with Escape (ideally click-outside too): close it and return focus to the trigger. Test it with the keyboard alone.
dom.limits: Rendered audit: honest heuristics, no substitute for a screen reader or manual review. Contrast computed over computed backgrounds; cases with background images are reported as "review". 2.5.8 allows exceptions (equivalent inline, spacing) approximated here.
dom.reduced_motion_ignored: {n} looping animations still run with prefers-reduced-motion set (before {n}, after {nr}): the user's preference is ignored (2.2.2).
dom.reduced_motion_ignored_rem: Wrap animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none } — or pause via the Animation API. The user asked for less motion; honor it.
dom.reflow_fail: {n} elements overflow at {w}px width (horizontal scroll): {det}. With correct reflow there is no one-dimensional scroll at 320px (1.4.10).
dom.reflow_fail_rem: Use fluid layouts (flex/grid, max-width instead of fixed width) and media queries: content must reflow to 320px without horizontal scroll. Exceptions: data tables, maps, charts.
dom.state_contrast: {n} controls with insufficient :focus/:hover state contrast (<3:1): {det}. Review.
dom.state_contrast_rem: The control text needs contrast when focused or hovered too (1.4.3); DISABLED controls are exempt under WCAG. Adjust the :focus and :hover colors.
dom.target_small: {n} controls with a touch area smaller than 24×24 px (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8): {det}.
dom.target_small_rem: Give controls at least 24×24 CSS px (44×44 is better) via padding or min-width/min-height. Exceptions: equivalent inline links and sufficient surrounding spacing.

evidence.manual_remaining: human review remaining after the machine, per class (MIN 1-3, MED 5-10, MAX 15-30 min per criterion)
evidence.no_signal: no automated signal exists for this criterion in this toolkit
evidence.not_flagged: not-flagged ≠ pass: no automated signal fired on this sample
evidence.notice: This pack is evidence, not conformance: it says what machines found and what remains for a human. A conformance claim requires the signature block completed by a qualified person who reviewed the manual list.
evidence.reviewer_note: any countersignature must reference pack.sha256 and state which criteria the human reviewed beyond the automated matrix
evidence.verified: verified against this sample per the manual checklist protocol

journey_dialog_trap: A dialog traps the keyboard and Escape does not close it.
Close the dialog on Escape and return focus to the trigger.
journey_duplicate_targets: Several controls share one accessible name: “the Buy button” is ambiguous by name alone.
Differentiate accessible names with context (aria-label, visible text).
journey_dynamic_stale: The tree changed after the action (content replaced) with no announcement — the agent’s map went stale.
Announce dynamic region updates (role=status/aria-live) and keep focus stable.
journey_error_silent: Submission failed and the error is neither announced nor focused.
Associate the error message with the field (aria-describedby) and move focus to the first error.
journey_focus_lost: After an action, focus disappeared or jumped somewhere unexpected.
Move focus programmatically to the logical destination after inserting or replacing content.
journey_generic_link: The destination of a key link is not understandable from its text.
Descriptive link text in context ("read more" says nothing alone).
journey_heading_nav_broken: Headings are missing or break the hierarchy: navigating by headings — a screen-reader user’s primary strategy — cannot find the section the task needs.
Use real heading markup in logical order (h1→h2…); never fake headings with bold text.
journey_hidden_in_tree: Information essential to the task is missing from the accessibility tree.
Express the relationship with real semantics (list, heading, table), not layout.
journey_landmark_missing: The page exposes no landmarks (main/nav): landmark navigation cannot skip the boilerplate.
Wrap content in real main/navigation landmarks; the skip link is a bonus, not the fix.
journey_mode_confusion: A custom widget swallows keystrokes or hides its role and state: browse-mode vs focus-mode switching breaks the interaction.
Use native elements (select, button) or the full ARIA pattern: role, state, keyboard support.
journey_no_instruction: The task required input whose format or requiredness was never stated.
Label the field with instructions and mark requiredness before the error does.
journey_reach_fail: A control needed for the task is not reachable or operable by keyboard.
Make it focusable and keyboard-operable; pointer-only is never enough.
journey_status_silent: The action result (success or loading) is not announced via a live region.
Announce the status change with role="status" or aria-live="polite".
journey_timeout_confusion: The task was lost to a time limit with no way to extend it.
Allow adjusting, extending or turning off the time limit.
journey_unnamed_control: A control needed for the task is announced without a name ("button", bare).
Give the control an accessible name: visible text, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

pdf.limits: Zero-dep structural screening: full PDF/UA conformance needs a spec validator (veraPDF). This screening finds what makes full validation pointless.
pdf.pdf_encrypted: encrypted PDF: readers may extract nothing.
pdf.pdf_encrypted_rem: Publish unencrypted (or with full extraction permissions).
pdf.pdf_fake_link: {n} text fragments styled like links (bluish fill / underlined with a rectangle) with no /A << /S /URI >> annotation on the page: screen readers do NOT announce them as links (2.4.4).
pdf.pdf_fake_link_rem: Use real link annotations (/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (…) >>) over the link text.
pdf.pdf_low_contrast: {n} text fragments with fill color near the background (ratio < 4.5): a PDF has no cascade — the current color is set by the `rg` operator before each Tj, and it is measurable. Examples: {ej}.
pdf.pdf_low_contrast_rem: Raise the text contrast: a PDF's default background is white if nothing is painted. Confirm the real background with veraPDF/acrobat.
pdf.pdf_no_alt: tagged tree with images but 0 /Alt entries: figures are opaque (1.1.1).
pdf.pdf_no_alt_rem: Add alternative text to figures on export/remediation.
pdf.pdf_no_lang: no /Lang: readers do not know what language to pronounce (3.1.1 for documents).
pdf.pdf_no_outline: no bookmarks/outline: a long PDF with no heading navigation (1.3.1).
pdf.pdf_no_outline_rem: Generate bookmarks from headings on export.
pdf.pdf_no_title: no /Title in metadata: readers announce the filename (2.4.2 for documents).
pdf.pdf_no_title_rem: Export with a document title (file properties), not the filename.
pdf.pdf_scanned: no text layer (0 characters in content): looks like a scan — fully invisible (1.1.1).
pdf.pdf_scanned_rem: Apply OCR with real text and tag the result.
pdf.pdf_untagged: no structure tree (/StructTreeRoot): reading order and semantic roles do not exist for the reader. THE root failure of inaccessible PDFs (1.3.1).
pdf.pdf_untagged_rem: Tag the document (export as tagged PDF from authoring, or remediate in Acrobat): without a tree, everything else is cosmetic.

scroll.limits: Infinite-scroll auditor: heuristics with real focus and a live-region observer over {n} batches. Not a substitute for screen-reader testing on the real feed.
scroll.scroll_focus: The focused element {where} after loading a batch ({detail}). Documented infinite-scroll failure: keyboard users lose their reading point (2.4.3).
scroll.scroll_focus_rem: Do not re-render the feed container: APPEND nodes at the end (appendChild/insertAdjacentHTML). If focus lands on removed content, move it to the new equivalent.
scroll.scroll_no_announce: {n} batches loaded with zero announcements: no aria-live/status region receives text during loading and the container lacks role="feed" (4.1.3).
scroll.scroll_no_announce_rem: Add a role="status" region with "Loading more…"/"10 new items" text and mark the container role="feed" with aria-busy while loading.
scroll.scroll_no_end: Infinite feed with no visible end after {n} batches and no "load more" button alternative: the footer stays unreachable (Deque guidance; akin to 2.2.2).
scroll.scroll_no_end_rem: Offer a "Load more" button (the most accessible option: explicit loading, predictable focus), a real feed end, or a control to pause auto-loading.
scroll.scroll_no_feed: The feed container does not use role="feed" with role="article" children (ARIA APG Feed pattern): screen readers cannot jump article by article.
scroll.scroll_no_feed_rem: Mark the container role="feed", each item role="article" with aria-labelledby, and use aria-busy during loading.

vtt.limits: Screening of caption CONTENT (1.2.2): not a substitute for human review of accuracy, speaker identification or audio description.
vtt.vtt_coverage: {pct}% coverage of the {dur}s of media — stretches without captions.
vtt.vtt_coverage_rem: Caption the missing stretches (or mark them as music/foreign language when true).
vtt.vtt_empty_cue: {n} cues with no text: time spent with no caption.
vtt.vtt_empty_cue_rem: Remove empty cues or add their missing text.
vtt.vtt_malformed_rem: Fix the "HH:MM:SS.mmm --> HH:MM:SS.mmm" format; a broken cue can be skipped whole by the player.
vtt.vtt_no_cues: the file declares WebVTT but contains no cues.
vtt.vtt_no_cues_rem: Caption for real: an empty track does not satisfy 1.2.2.
vtt.vtt_overlap_rem: Cues must not overlap: some players show both at once.
vtt.vtt_too_fast_rem: Split the cue or extend its time: >21 cps is unreadable (BBC/Netflix standard).

wcag3.disclaimer: Preview based on the WCAG 3 Working Draft of 10 September 2026. WCAG 3 is not a completed standard, does not replace WCAG 2.2 and cannot ground any conformance claim. This preview only re-groups existing WCAG 2.2 findings under the draft's outcomes.
wcag3.mapping_note: The criterion-to-outcome mapping is curated by a11y-toolkit: the W3C has not published an official WCAG 2 to WCAG 3 mapping (transition materials are planned). Treat every grouping as an approximation.
wcag3.model_tags: Core requirement tags in the draft: physical harm, risk, barrier and friction (per the W3C introduction; they qualify requirements, not findings).
wcag3.model_tiers: Reporting tiers 1-6, where tier 3 corresponds to conformance. Counts and thresholds are still to be determined by the W3C.
wcag3.no_score: No score, tier or conformance level is produced on purpose: the draft's tier thresholds are still to be determined by the W3C.
